2026So Far: Five for Five, and the Favorite Can't Catch a BreakIn progress · 5 weeks in · Birdgangflyeagles 9-1, Goldminers1 7-3, dahlilama 7-3

Five weeks in, Birdgangflyeagles is still perfect head-to-head, beat the futures favorite to prove it, and made his first trade of the year. Goldminers1 keeps piling up points, and dahlilama has lost twice while scoring 125-plus. The evidence so far.

Five for five

Birdgangflyeagles beat dahlilama 144.36–125.84 with the top score of Week 5. He's now 5-0 head-to-head and 9-1 overall, and his only loss of the year is still to the league median. He also made his first trade: Lamar Jackson and Harold Fannin to Bjspjs4 for Isaiah Likely. Last year he went 3-11. One more win ties his own career-best six-game streak from 2023. The jury is starting to take him seriously.

dahlilama, unlucky twice

dahlilama has now scored 125.40 and 125.84 in back-to-back weeks and lost both. This week's 125.84 was above the median, so he banked the median win and sits at 7-3, third on points tiebreak. He's still the futures favorite at +200 and second in the league in points (657). Two straight head-to-head losses, though, and the jury noticed.

Goldminers1 keeps cashing checks

Goldminers1 beat Bjspjs4 141.64–107.10, the week's second-best score, for his third straight head-to-head win. He's 7-3 and leads the league with 684 points, 27 ahead of dahlilama. His Week 3 175.08 is still the third-highest score in league history and the fourth-biggest blowout ever (+80.56).

Bjspjs4 goes shopping again

That Lamar Jackson deal was Bjspjs4's fourth trade of the season, the most in the league. It didn't help right away: he lost to Goldminers1 for his third straight head-to-head loss and is 4-6, with 634.58 points against, second-most in the league. After seven trades last year, nobody expected him to stop.

Also in the file

  • juleon8 beat elysianbeer 119.08–78.22 to get to 5-5, and now has the fewest points against in the league (451). That ended elysianbeer's three-game head-to-head streak; he's 6-4 and fourth.
  • kevinnguu won the week's biggest blowout, 124.70–73.34 over giJ03, for two straight wins. He's 5-5. giJ03's 73.34 was the week's low score.
  • MayockJr beat rbanuelos3 135.54–115.36 and is 4-6. He leads the league in moves with 24.
  • showmeyourtd23 got his first head-to-head win, 113.50–99.14 over Sleon1000. Sleon1000 is 0-5 head-to-head and 2-8, with the most points against in the league (635.74).
  • The middle is crowded: rbanuelos3, kevinnguu and juleon8 are all 5-5.

cases.dahlilama: 2023 champ, 2025 runner-up and Points King, 4-1 all-time in the playoffs. 7-3, and second in the league in points.
cases.Birdgangflyeagles: 9-1 and 5-0 head-to-head. Made his first trade of the year in Week 5. Has been a 1 seed and a last-place team. No middle gear.
cases.rbanuelos3: Owns the season points record (1,858) and the highest score ever (180.24). Two playoff trips, no ring, and 5-5 after his 8-game head-to-head win streak ended in Week 3.
cases.juleon8: Owns the league-record 11-game head-to-head win streak, snapped by 1.82 points in Week 4. Went from 1-5 to the 3 seed last year.
cases.Goldminers1: Four seasons, no playoff trips yet, and a league-record 10 weekly low scores. Also leads the league in points after a 175.08 and a 144.32.
cases.Sleon1000: Best all-time record (26-16) and two straight #1 seeds, but 0-2 in the playoffs and 2-8 this year.
cases.kevinnguu: Rookie. 122.86 in his debut, and his first head-to-head win came against the futures favorite.
cases.elysianbeer: Dropped 152.58 in Week 4, the top score of that week. 6-4. Still paying off last October's trade.
cases.MayockJr: The league's busiest manager. 61 moves last year turned a 7-7 team into a third-place finish.
cases.giJ03: Rookie, 4-6, and his Week 2 55.74 is already on the all-time low-score list. The field.
cases.showmeyourtd23: Reached the first title game without making a trade. Hasn't made the playoffs since.
cases.Bjspjs4: 4-6 with four trades already, the latest for Lamar Jackson, drafting from slot 8, the slot that's won all three titles. The 17-25 career mark is why the number's this long.
